definitions.historical_numeric_faithfulness: Numeric precision: matched stated decimals / stated decimals; empty stated set receives 1.0. Not recall.
definitions.current_numeric_recall: Distinct expected rounded numeric values mentioned within tolerance / distinct expected numeric values; omitting all numbers receives 0 when facts exist.
definitions.current_source_date_provenance: Any exact date OR source token substring occurs; date alone counts. This is stricter than generic source keywords but does not require actual source identity.
definitions.stronger_source_identity: Exact case-specific source identifier or source URL must occur; date alone does not count. Requires archived answers and case-specific source mappings.
definitions.numeric_parser_limit: Current decimal-only regex -?\d+\.\d+ ignores integer and scientific-notation expressions and does not align numbers to metric roles; set-based recall collapses equal-valued metrics.
definitions.unsupported_assertions_limit: Keyword matches are heuristic flags, not validated semantic entailment judgments.
